description: This file contains script functions for managing Git-based extension detection and change tracking within a project. It provides utilities for resolving Git revisions, listing changed paths, and identifying which extensions have been altered based on the repository's file states.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Runs a Git command asynchronously with specified arguments and options, returning the command's output.
parameters: args: array of Git command arguments

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts file paths to a normalized form with '/' separators regardless of the OS.

methods.name: hasGitCommit
methods.description: Checks if a specific Git commit or reference exists in the repository.
parameters: ref: string Git reference to verify

methods.name: resolveChangedPathsBase
methods.description: Determines the base revision for listing changed files, considering fallbacks and remote references.
parameters: params: object with base, head, and fallbackBaseRef properties

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Lists file paths changed between two Git revisions.
parameters: head: optional string ending revision, defaults to 'HEAD'

methods.name: hasExtensionPackage
methods.description: Checks if an extension has a package.json file, indicating its presence.
parameters: extensionId: string identifier of the extension

methods.name: listAvailableExtensionIds
methods.description: Provides a list of all available extension IDs in the plugin directory that have a package.json.

methods.name: detectChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Analyzes changed paths to identify which extensions have been modified.

methods.name: listChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Determines the list of extension IDs that have changed based on current and base revisions, handling errors or fallback behaviors.
parameters: params: object with head, unavailableBaseBehavior, fallbackBaseRef, and base
